name: io.github.sepehr071/digikala-mcp
title: Digikala
description: Unofficial read-only Digikala: search products, compare sellers, price history, reviews, deals.

environmentVariables.name: DIGIKALA_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for every request (e.g. one with an Iranian exit if Digikala blocks yours), or a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next. System proxy settings are ignored.
